label: weather_query
text: Mbula ekobeta na ngonga nini?
english_meaning: What time will it rain?

label: weather_query
text: Mbula ekobeta mikolo boni?
english_meaning: For how many days will it rain?

label: weather_query
text: E zali na likama ya mopepe makasi?
english_meaning: Is there a risk of strong winds?

label: weather_query
text: Nakoki kobima sans parapluie?
english_meaning: Can I go out without an umbrella?

label: weather_query
text: Température ya butu ekozala boni?
english_meaning: What will the night temperature be?

label: weather_query
text: Na ntongo malili ekozala mingi?
english_meaning: Will it be very cold in the morning?

label: weather_query
text: Mbula ekobeta na eteni nini ya engumba?
english_meaning: Which part of the city will get rain?

label: weather_query
text: Météo ya suka ya poso ezali ndenge nini?
english_meaning: What is the weekend forecast?

label: datetime_query
text: Tokomi na ngonga nini sikoyo?
english_meaning: What time is it now?

label: datetime_query
text: Mokolo ya lelo ezali mokolo ya boni na sanza?
english_meaning: What date is today?

label: datetime_query
text: Sanza oyo ezali na mikolo boni?
english_meaning: How many days are in this month?

label: datetime_query
text: Posó ekosila mokolo nini?
english_meaning: What day does the week end?

label: datetime_query
text: Lelo ezali mokolo ya mosala to ya bopemi?
english_meaning: Is today a working day or a rest day?

label: datetime_query
text: Sanza nini ekolanda oyo?
english_meaning: Which month comes after this one?

label: datetime_query
text: Mobu oyo ekosila mokolo nini?
english_meaning: What day will this year end?

label: datetime_query
text: Tokomi na mobu nini?
english_meaning: What year is it?
